definitions.explanation: Positive: done in an impressive, admirable way
Can emphasize completeness, sometimes of a failure

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見事|みごと}に⟦{勝|か}った→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見事|みごと}に⟦やり{遂|と}げた→やり遂げる：16745_yaritogeru⟧。
examples.english: He accomplished the difficult task brilliantly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{見事|みごと}に⟦{咲|さ}き{誇|ほこ}っている→咲き誇る：11834_sakihokoru⟧。
examples.english: The cherry blossoms are blooming magnificently.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{見事|みごと}に⟦{外|はず}れた→外れる：02395_hazureru⟧。
⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{見事|みごと}に⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{嘘|うそ}→嘘：01796_uso⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{見事|みごと}に⟦{見抜|みぬ}かれた→見抜く：06975_minuku⟧。
examples.english: His lie was completely seen through.

notes:
The adverbial form of ⟦{見事|みごと}→見事：03744_migoto⟧ (na-adjective meaning splendid/magnificent). Has two distinct uses: expressing admiration for something done impressively well, or emphasizing the completeness or thoroughness of something — including negative outcomes.

USAGE:
With positive verbs (sense 1), it praises the quality of an achievement. With negative outcomes (sense 2), it emphasizes how completely or thoroughly something went wrong, often with a touch of irony.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {見事|みごと}に⟦{成功|せいこう}する→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧: to succeed brilliantly
- {見事|みごと}に⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fail spectacularly
- {見事|みごと}に⟦{外|はず}れる→外れる：02395_hazureru⟧: to be completely off the mark
- {見事|みごと}に⟦{咲|さ}く→咲く：08150_saku⟧: to bloom magnificently
- {見事|みごと}に⟦やり{遂|と}げる→やり遂げる：16745_yaritogeru⟧: to accomplish brilliantly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{立派|りっぱ}→立派：01093_rippa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: admirably, splendidly — similar but only used positively
- ⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: completely — neutral emphasis on completeness without the "impressively" nuance
